'''Jana Small Finance Bank''' is a [[small finance bank]] that commenced operations on March 28, 2018, headquartered in [[Bangalore]], India.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jana Small Finance Bank|url=https://www.janabank.com/|access-date=2021-03-15|website=www.janabank.com|language=en-gb}}</ref> 

== History ==
The [[Reserve Bank of India]] issued a licence to the bank under Section 22 (1) of the [[Banking Regulation Act, 1949]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kattoor |first1=Jose J. |title=Jana Small Finance Bank Limited commences operations |url=https://rbidocs.rbi.org.in/rdocs/PressRelease/PDFs/PR259264409DB3AE7E4D22A11BCBA8054B80AE.PDF |website=Reserve Bank of India |access-date=July 7, 2019 |date=March 28, 2018}}</ref> Prior to becoming a bank, the company was India's largest [[Microfinance#Microfinance_on_the_Indian_subcontinent|microfinance]] institution, Janalakshmi Financial Services,<ref name="livemint">{{cite news |last1=Gopakumar |first1=Gopika |title=Jana Small Finance Bank launches commercial operations |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/uUiqrEPO9N8LhZ1i53FuPM/Jana-Small-Finance-Bank-launches-commercial-operations.html |access-date=July 7, 2019 |work=livemint.com |date=July 18, 2018 |language=en}}</ref> founded July 24, 2006.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/3667144Z:IN |website=Bloomberg |access-date=7 July 2019}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite news |last1=Jordan |first1=Dorris, M |title=Finance |url=http://dollarbureau.com |access-date=21 December 2021}}</ref>
As a microfinance lender, the company survived large losses following the [[2016 Indian banknote demonetisation]], reporting total losses of ₹2,504 crore (US${{To USD|25040|IND|round=yes}} million) at the time of its conversion to a small finance bank.<ref name="livemint" /> Jana reported in November 2019 that the September 2019 quarter was its first profitable quarter since demonetisation.<ref name="tpg">{{cite news |last1=Dhanjal |first1=Swaraj Singh |title=TPG Capital leads ₹225 cr funding round in Jana Small Finance Bank |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/tpg-capital-leads-225-cr-funding-round-in-jana-small-finance-bank-11573153187902.html |access-date=12 November 2019 |work=livemint.com |date=8 November 2019 |language=en}}</ref>

== DigiGen ==
DigiGen is a [[digital banking]] platform launched by Jana Small Finance Bank.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.janabank.com/savings-account/digigen-by-jana-small-finance-bank/|title=DIGIGEN by Jana Small Finance Bank|language=en-gb}}</ref> 

== Shareholding ==
Major investors in Jana include US-based [[private equity]] fund managers [[TPG Capital]] and [[HarbourVest Partners]].<ref name=tpg/>
